title: Nickel Nanoparticles Promote Lung Adenocarcinoma Progression via CDK1-Mediated Fatty Acid Metabolism Regulation.
authors: Wu, Rui-Ze; Zhang, Bo; Yu, Han-Nong; Sun, Qian-Qian; Yao, Wen-Xue; Liu, Wei-Yang; Lv, Jun-Jie; Xu, Zhi-Wei; Qi, Hong-Qing; Fu, Yao; Zhao, A-Yang; Pan, Yu-Lin; Wu, Yong-Hui; Xin, Rui
one_liner_zh: 研究镍纳米颗粒通过CDK1/STAT3/FASN轴促进肺腺癌进展，核心是细胞实验与动物模型，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Nickel nanoparticles (NiNPs) are extensively used in nanotechnology, electronics, and biomedical fields, raising concerns about their pulmonary toxicity and potential role in inducing lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). While heavy metals, like arsenic and cadmium, are well-known to drive LUAD through metabolic reprogramming, the molecular mechanism linking NiNPs to LUAD-particularly their impact on fatty acid metabolism (FAM)-remains unclear. This study is the first to explore whether NiNPs promote LUAD progression via the CDK1/STAT3/FASN axis, a key regulator of FAM, and to evaluate the natural compound apigenin (API) as a potential inhibitory agent. When human (A549) and mouse (LLC) LUAD cells were exposed to NiNPs, assessments of cell function and protein expression revealed increased malignant phenotypes, including enhanced proliferation, migration, invasion, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), along with activation of the CDK1/STAT3/FASN axis and upregulation of FAM-related markers. Genetic silencing of either CDK1 or FASN reversed the dysregulation of FAM and reduced the malignant characteristics of the cells. Molecular docking analysis confirmed that API binds strongly to CDK1, and further experiments demonstrated that API suppresses NiNP-induced tumor growth both in laboratory cell models and in living organisms, while also blocking the activity of the CDK1/STAT3/FASN axis.
abstract_zh: 镍纳米颗粒（NiNPs）在纳米技术、电子和生物医学领域被广泛使用，引发了对它们肺毒性及其在诱导肺腺癌（LUAD）中潜在作用的担忧。虽然重金属，如砷和镉，已知通过代谢重编程驱动LUAD，但连接NiNPs与LUAD的分子机制——特别是它们对脂肪酸代谢（FAM）的影响——仍不清楚。本研究首次探讨NiNPs是否通过CDK1/STAT3/FASN轴（FAM的关键调控因子）促进LUAD进展，并评估天然化合物芹菜素（API）作为潜在抑制剂的效力。当人（A549）和小鼠（LLC）LUAD细胞暴露于NiNPs时，细胞功能和蛋白质表达评估显示恶性表型增加，包括增殖、迁移、侵袭和上皮-间质转化（EMT）增强，同时CDK1/STAT3/FASN轴被激活，FAM相关标志物上调。对CDK1或FASN进行基因沉默可逆转FAM的失调，并降低细胞的恶性特征。分子对接分析确认API与CDK1强结合，进一步实验表明，API在实验室细胞模型和活体生物中均抑制NiNP诱导的肿瘤生长，同时阻断CDK1/STAT3/FASN轴的活性。
